name: Enterprise External Norm and Applicability Assessment
constraints: WM-POL-001 owns legal work, expression, manifestation, provision and normalized norm identities.
WM-KNW-012 owns attributable enterprise interpretations that pin source work, expression and provision without replacing source text.
WM-ACT-034 applicability assessments pin norm version, provisions, subject context, jurisdiction, facts-as-of, assessor competence, reasoning, evidence and limitations.
WM-XCT-029 obligations retain legal basis, obligor, action, conditions, due basis, fulfilment criteria and evidence.
Publication, commencement, applicability, deadline, repeal and knowledge time remain distinct.
Applicability, obligation and compliance remain separate claims and conflicting assessments coexist without implicit majority resolution.
holds: Jurisdiction must bind to a governed place, polity and authority master before publication.
Assessment-series and relation-ledger issues require reconciliation.
Independent Grok review, specialist review, immutable source pins and frozen audit remain pending.
